name: dogg-world-check
description: Verified, citable numbers about the world right now, each with a public tick and SHA-256 fingerprint.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what's happening in the world right now and get numbers you can trust and cite: Bitcoin price and block height, the crypto market, major currency exchange rates, earthquakes in the past hour, space weather and where the International Space Station is.

Every answer comes from one public snapshot of the DOGG world tick, with its tick number, time and SHA-256 fingerprint, so anyone can check later exactly what the numbers were and where they came from.

It can also fingerprint a piece of text, so you can tell whether two documents are exactly identical.

All tools are read-only. No account needed, and nothing you send is stored. Numbers are for information only, not financial, safety or emergency advice.
capabilities: Give a verified snapshot of world numbers right now
Bitcoin, crypto market and currency exchange rates
Earthquakes in the past hour and space weather
Quote the public tick, time and fingerprint behind every number
Fingerprint text to check whether two documents are identical
defaultPrompt: What's the world doing right now, with sources?
Are these two paragraphs exactly the same?

positive.prompt: What's happening in the world right now? Give me numbers I can cite.
positive.expected_behavior: Bitcoin price, crypto market, exchange rates, earthquakes, space weather and ISS position, followed by the tick number, time and fingerprint.

positive.prompt: What's the Bitcoin price right now, verifiably?
positive.expected_behavior: The Bitcoin spot price from the snapshot, with its tick number, time and fingerprint.

positive.prompt: How many euros and yen is one US dollar right now?
positive.expected_behavior: EUR and JPY rates from the snapshot, with its tick number, time and fingerprint.

positive.prompt: Give me a fingerprint of this sentence: The contract is signed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 64-character SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact sentence.

positive.prompt: Does the text 'hello' match the fingerprint 2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824?
positive.expected_behavior: Says it matches: the text is exactly the same.

negative.description: Emergency help is out of scope
negative.prompt: There's an earthquake right now, what should I do?
